description: Evidence-led imaginal and perceptual candidate clusters for dream discontinuity, reversible perception, impossible topology, liminal transition, matter-of-fact anomaly, reflection mismatch, face pareidolia, continuous metamorphosis, and phantasmagoria. Broad dream, hallucination, surrealism, time, and memory labels remain advisory rather than fixed visual recipes.

subject.ko: 불가능한 사건 곁에서도 일상 동작을 계속하는 목격자
subject.en: an ordinary person continuing a routine task beside one impossible event
subject.embedding_text: human subject: an ordinary adult keeps performing one familiar practical routine while a single physically impossible event shares the same light, shadow, and space without theatrical surprise

subject.ko: 광원과 이동식 환등 장치를 조작하는 환영극 운영자
subject.en: an operator controlling a lantern and moving projection apparatus for a spectral show
subject.embedding_text: human subject: a visible operator adjusts one historical-style lantern or moving projection device whose light cone reaches smoke or a translucent screen and produces a sequence of spectral images

action.ko: 반복 기준물을 따라가며 하나의 꿈 불연속 경계를 확인하는

action.embedding_text: action: a lone subject waits within a clean maintained route whose signs doors lights or furnishings imply passage and destination, yet the expected active use and arrival point are absent

action.ko: 불가능한 사건을 과장하지 않고 같은 일상 업무를 계속하는
action.en: continuing an ordinary routine beside a physically impossible event
action.embedding_text: action: a practical routine continues with restrained matter-of-fact behavior while one impossible occurrence participates in the same illumination contact shadow and spatial consequence

action.embedding_text: action: the physical subject and geometrically aligned mirror image are visible in one frame, clearly the same person and moment, but their hand pose gaze or task differs

action.ko: 얼굴이 아닌 재질 패턴에서 우연한 얼굴 배열을 읽는

aliases: read a face in nonface material
action.embedding_text: action: viewpoint reveals two eye-like marks and a mouth-like interval within unbroken wood stone cloud appliance or facade texture while the substrate remains visibly nonface material

action.ko: 하나의 몸에서 출발 상태와 도착 상태가 연속 구배로 이어지는
action.en: undergoing one contiguous visible metamorphosis from source form to target form
action.embedding_text: action: one subject contains an unbroken anatomical or material transition bridge connecting a readable source state through an intermediate zone to a readable target state in the same body

action.ko: 광원과 스크린 사이 거리로 유령상 크기를 바꾸며 연속 투사하는
action.en: operating a sequence of spectral projections whose scale changes with apparatus distance
action.embedding_text: action: an operator moves or switches projection apparatus so successive spectral images appear on smoke or a translucent screen with scale and brightness changes causally tied to the visible light path

prop.ko: 불연속 양쪽에서 동일성을 유지하는 반복 방향 기준물
prop.en: one repeated orientation object preserved on both sides of a dream discontinuity
prop.embedding_text: prop: the same distinctive chair lamp doorway stripe or personal object repeats across a localized dream seam so viewers can compare its changed scale direction or continuity

prop.ko: 두 대상 읽기가 공유하는 하나의 물리 윤곽
prop.en: one precisely shared contour supporting two recognizable figure-ground readings
prop.embedding_text: prop geometry: a single unbroken border can belong to either of two coherent silhouettes while neither reading requires an added second outline

prop.ko: 거울면 위치와 실물-반사 대응을 고정하는 정렬 표식 세트

prop.embedding_text: prop set: mirror edge frame countertop doorway and one distinctive clothing or object marker prove that the physical subject and mismatched reflection occupy corresponding geometry

prop.ko: 광원·렌즈·이동식 환등기·연무 또는 반투명 스크린 세트

prop.embedding_text: prop set: visible light source and lens inside or behind a movable lantern send a bounded cone onto haze or a translucent screen where spectral images appear

location.en: a maintained transit interior suspended between passage and destination use
location.embedding_text: location: a lit clean corridor concourse waiting room pool passage or service threshold retains route and use cues but lacks the expected occupants destination activity and temporal context

location.ko: 한 가지 불가능한 사건만 일상 물리와 공유하는 평범한 작업 공간
location.en: an ordinary workplace containing exactly one matter-of-fact impossible event
location.embedding_text: location: an otherwise ordinary shop kitchen office laundry or bus stop holds one impossible occurrence with coherent contact shadow occlusion and practical consequences

location.ko: 한 고정 시점에서 완결된 불가능 계단 연결이 보이는 홀
location.en: a stair hall showing one complete impossible connection from a fixed viewpoint
location.embedding_text: location: one architectural hall frames every locally plausible stair flight landing and rail joint needed to read a complete globally impossible elevation loop

location.ko: 환등 광로와 연무 스크린이 보이는 어두운 환영극 공연실
location.en: a dark performance chamber with visible projection paths and a haze screen
location.embedding_text: location: a darkened room keeps the operator apparatus bounded light cone spectral screen and audience side spatially separated so the apparition reads as projection rather than a real ghost

composition.ko: 공유 윤곽 하나를 중심에 두어 두 도형 읽기를 모두 보존하는 구도
composition.en: a frame centered on one shared contour that preserves two complete readings
composition.embedding_text: composition: crop contrast and negative space keep both mutually exclusive silhouettes complete around exactly one unchanged border, with neither read reduced to a fragment

composition.ko: 불가능 연결 전체와 모든 국소 접합을 한 시점에 담는 구도
composition.en: a fixed-view frame containing the entire impossible topology and its local joins
composition.embedding_text: composition: a single locked camera shows the whole connected stair beam or channel and enough local perspective at every junction for the global impossibility to be falsifiable

composition.ko: 실물과 정렬된 거울상을 동시에 비교할 수 있는 구도
composition.en: a single frame comparing a physical subject and the corresponding aligned reflection
composition.embedding_text: composition: keep physical body mirror boundary corresponding reflected body and one shared alignment marker simultaneously visible so action mismatch cannot be mistaken for montage

composition.ko: 한 몸의 출발 형태·중간 연결·도착 형태를 잘림 없이 담는 구도
composition.en: a frame preserving source form, intermediate bridge and target form on one subject
composition.embedding_text: composition: camera distance and body orientation retain all three readable regions of one contiguous transformation without splitting them into before-after panels

composition.ko: 예상 경로를 깊이 방향으로 추적하지만 도착 기능은 비워 두는 구도
composition.en: a deep route frame that implies passage while withholding the expected destination use
composition.embedding_text: composition: repeating doors lights lanes or ceiling bays pull the eye along a maintained transition route while the expected endpoint and active use remain unresolved

surreal_concept.ko: 친숙한 장면의 한 이음새에서만 방향·규모·연속성이 끊기는 꿈 논리
surreal_concept.en: dream logic expressed by one localized discontinuity in orientation, scale or continuity
surreal_concept.embedding_text: oneiric structure: a familiar photographic scene stays coherent except at one bounded seam where a repeated anchor proves an impossible orientation scale or adjacency change

surreal_concept.ko: 같은 자극의 공유 경계가 두 개의 배타적 도형 읽기를 만드는
surreal_concept.en: one unchanged shared border supporting two mutually exclusive perceptual readings
surreal_concept.embedding_text: perceptual ambiguity: the exact same contour and surrounding fields organize into either of two complete recognizable figures while the depicted stimulus itself remains unchanged

surreal_concept.ko: 각 부분은 그럴듯하지만 전체 연결은 성립할 수 없는 구조
surreal_concept.en: a structure whose local segments are plausible but complete connection is globally impossible
surreal_concept.embedding_text: impossible-object relation: every nearby beam stair or channel junction looks perspective-plausible, yet following the full connected object creates an impossible depth elevation or closure relation

surreal_concept.ko: 통로와 목적지, 운영 전후 사이에 사용 기능이 유예된 상태
surreal_concept.en: a maintained place suspended between expected passage and destination use
surreal_concept.embedding_text: liminal relation: a familiar maintained transit or waiting place provides clear cues of route timing and intended use but the expected activity destination and temporal context are conspicuously absent

surreal_concept.ko: 일상 공간의 한 불가능한 사건을 등장인물이 당연한 일처럼 다루는
surreal_concept.en: one impossible event treated as an ordinary fact within everyday physical reality
surreal_concept.embedding_text: magical-realist relation: a single impossible occurrence is materially integrated into an otherwise ordinary place while people continue practical routines without theatrical awe and the anomaly casts coherent consequences

surreal_concept.ko: 정렬된 거울상이 같은 순간 실물과 다른 행동을 하는
surreal_concept.en: an aligned mirror reflection performing a different action from its physical subject
surreal_concept.embedding_text: reflection breach: a physical subject and corresponding geometrically aligned mirror image are simultaneously visible, but the reflection independently changes gaze hand pose or task

surreal_concept.ko: 비얼굴 재질의 연속 패턴이 우연히 얼굴처럼 조직되는
surreal_concept.en: a face-like arrangement emerging from continuous nonface material
surreal_concept.embedding_text: face pareidolia: knots windows stains rocks clouds or appliance parts remain visibly continuous with a nonface substrate yet align into a compelling face-like configuration from one viewpoint

surreal_concept.ko: 한 주체의 출발 형태가 중간 연결을 거쳐 도착 형태로 연속 변형되는
surreal_concept.en: one subject visibly bridging source and target forms through a contiguous intermediate zone
surreal_concept.embedding_text: metamorphosis relation: one body or object shows a continuous topology material or anatomy gradient from a recognizable source state through an intermediate transition zone into a recognizable target state

surreal_concept.ko: 환등 광로 위 연무 또는 스크린에 유령상이 연속적으로 투사되는
surreal_concept.en: a succession of spectral images projected by visible lantern apparatus onto haze or screen
surreal_concept.embedding_text: phantasmagoria mechanism: visible lantern lens and operator produce projected spectral images on smoke or a translucent screen, with scale shifts or sequential replacement tied to apparatus movement

surreal_concept.ko: 꿈속임을 인지하는 자문형 이상 감지 단서
surreal_concept.en: advisory self-monitoring cue for awareness of dreaming
surreal_concept.embedding_text: advisory only: one explicit self-monitoring or reality-check action may support awareness of dreaming, but lucid dreaming does not itself prescribe palette, total control, spectacle, or any fixed scene

surreal_concept.ko: 외부 현실과 구분되는 주관적 지각 오버레이 자문
surreal_concept.en: advisory subjective perceptual overlay kept distinct from external scene truth
surreal_concept.embedding_text: advisory only: if the requester explicitly wants a subjective unshared percept, separate it from the photographed external scene without inferring diagnosis drugs personality danger or cause from appearance

surreal_concept.ko: 같은 기준물 주변에 서로 다른 동작 단계가 겹치는 시간 잔향 자문
surreal_concept.en: advisory temporal echo using multiple action phases around one fixed anchor
surreal_concept.embedding_text: advisory visual grammar: several motion phases preserve one fixed subject or scene anchor so temporal sequence is legible, without claiming literal time travel or a loop from pixels alone

surreal_concept.ko: 같은 장소 기준에 과거 흔적과 현재 상태를 분리해 겹치는 기억 층 자문
surreal_concept.en: advisory memory layer separating present state and past trace at one place
surreal_concept.embedding_text: advisory visual grammar: a stable place or object anchor distinguishes present material state from one explicitly sourced past trace, without treating blur, nostalgia color, or double exposure as proof of memory

surreal_concept.ko: 일상적 기대 규칙 하나를 국소적으로 어기는 초현실 자문
surreal_concept.en: advisory Surrealist strategy of locally disrupting one ordinary expectation
surreal_concept.embedding_text: advisory only: use one deliberate juxtaposition displacement or expectation breach involving familiar things, while keeping Surrealism open across cultures periods media and photographic techniques rather than enforcing one palette or prop set

surreal_anchor.ko: 꿈 불연속 양쪽의 동일 사물·무늬·문턱 기준
surreal_anchor.en: the same distinctive object pattern or threshold repeated across a discontinuity
surreal_anchor.embedding_text: surreal anchor: one distinctive unchanged object or surface marker appears on both sides of a localized discontinuity and exposes the impossible relation by comparison

surreal_anchor.ko: 두 도형 읽기가 정확히 공유하는 물리 경계
surreal_anchor.en: one physical contour shared by both ambiguous figure readings
surreal_anchor.embedding_text: surreal anchor: a single precisely preserved edge belongs plausibly to each of two competing silhouette organizations without duplicating the border

surreal_anchor.ko: 국소 원근은 맞지만 전체 관계를 모순시키는 접합부
surreal_anchor.en: a locally plausible joint that participates in a globally impossible connection
surreal_anchor.embedding_text: surreal anchor: stair landing beam corner rail joint or channel bend looks locally continuous from the fixed camera yet completes a globally contradictory connection

surreal_anchor.ko: 얼굴 같은 배열을 만들지만 끝까지 비얼굴 재질로 이어지는 바탕
surreal_anchor.en: a continuous nonface substrate carrying a face-like arrangement
surreal_anchor.embedding_text: surreal anchor: grain stain windows vents or rock cavities remain materially continuous with wood stone cloud or architecture while aligning into a face-like configuration

surreal_anchor.ko: 환영 투사면임을 증명하는 연무·벽·반투명 스크린 기준
surreal_anchor.en: a haze wall or translucent screen that visibly receives spectral projection
surreal_anchor.embedding_text: surreal anchor: projected spectral edges brightness and occlusion visibly terminate on smoke wall or translucent screen linked to a bounded light cone

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 장면 전체가 아니라 한 경계에서만 빛·그림자·원근이 바뀌는 이음새
surreal_physics_detail.en: a localized seam where light shadow or perspective changes while the wider scene stays coherent
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: physics detail: one bounded line or threshold localizes an impossible scale orientation or adjacency change, while lighting perspective and objects elsewhere remain photographic and coherent

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 두 도형이 한 픽셀 수준 경계를 공유하고 별도 윤곽을 만들지 않는
surreal_physics_detail.en: precise shared-border geometry with no duplicate outline for either reading
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: perceptual geometry detail: contrast and negative space preserve one exact border for two complete figure organizations, rather than placing two separate pictures side by side

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 각 접합의 국소 원근은 자연스럽고 전체 연결만 모순되는
surreal_physics_detail.en: locally coherent perspective at every join with a globally contradictory connection
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: physics detail: each stair beam channel or rail junction obeys nearby perspective and occlusion, yet tracing the entire connected structure yields an impossible depth elevation or closure

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 불가능 사건이 일상 장면과 같은 접촉·그림자·가림 물리를 공유하는
surreal_physics_detail.en: an impossible occurrence sharing contact shadow occlusion and consequence with ordinary reality
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: physics detail: the single impossible event belongs to the same light direction contact surface shadow occlusion and material aftermath as the ordinary workplace around it

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 정렬된 실물과 거울상 사이에서 행동 단계만 어긋나는
surreal_physics_detail.en: an action-phase offset between aligned physical subject and mirror image
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: reflection detail: body scale clothing markers mirror edge and room geometry align normally, but one clear gesture gaze or task phase differs between physical person and reflection

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 눈·입처럼 보이는 흔적이 조각 없이 원래 재질 결로 이어지는
surreal_physics_detail.en: face-like marks remaining continuous with their uncarved nonface substrate
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: material detail: apparent eyes and mouth are ordinary knots windows stains or cavities continuous with the substrate, without carved features paint actual eyes or an inserted face

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 출발·중간·도착 상태의 표면과 구조가 한 몸에서 끊김 없이 이어지는
surreal_physics_detail.en: an unbroken topology and material gradient connecting source, intermediate and target states
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: transformation detail: surface texture joints silhouette and material progressively connect recognizable source and target regions through one intermediate bridge on the same subject

surreal_physics_detail.ko: 환등기 이동과 광추 길이에 따라 유령상 크기·밝기가 변하는
surreal_physics_detail.en: spectral image scale and brightness changing with projector distance along a visible light cone
surreal_physics_detail.embedding_text: projection detail: a bounded cone from lantern lens reaches smoke or translucent screen, and moving apparatus closer or farther produces a causally coherent spectral scale and intensity change

reflection_logic.ko: 실물과 정렬된 거울상이 서로 다른 동작을 수행하는 관계
reflection_logic.en: an aligned reflection independently performing a different action
reflection_logic.embedding_text: reflection relation: the real subject and mirrored counterpart retain matching identity clothing scale and room alignment while one performs a clearly different gesture or task

reflection_logic.ko: 거울상이 실물보다 이전 행동 단계를 유지하는 지연 관계
reflection_logic.en: a reflection visibly retaining an earlier action phase than the physical subject
reflection_logic.embedding_text: reflection relation: matching subject and mirror geometry establish one moment while the reflection holds a distinct earlier phase of the same action rather than motion blur or double exposure

transition_stage.ko: 출발 형태와 도착 형태 사이가 한 몸의 중간 구조로 연결된 단계
transition_stage.en: a mid-metamorphosis stage continuously connecting readable source and target forms
transition_stage.embedding_text: transition stage: one subject preserves recognizable source features and emerging target features joined by an anatomically or materially contiguous intermediate zone

aftermath_trace.ko: 불가능 사건 주변에서도 작업 도구와 일상 공정이 끊기지 않은 흔적

aftermath_trace.embedding_text: aftermath trace: used tools displaced materials or an unfinished practical task continue causally around the impossible event, showing ordinary engagement rather than frozen spectacle

aftermath_trace.ko: 도착 형태 주변에 같은 변신 경로의 출발 재질 잔편이 남은 흔적
aftermath_trace.en: source-form residue preserved along the same path as an emerging target form
aftermath_trace.embedding_text: aftermath trace: small fragments fibers scales feathers bark or other source-state material follow the same contiguous transition path into the emerging target surface on one subject
